name: Compliance Overview
summary: Compliance Overview — judges the estate against its audit benchmarks. Consolidated compliance over the compliance table: pass/fail/warning, the controls failing the most assets, framework rollup (NIST/PCI/HIPAA/CIS/ISO), and per-asset scorecards. Assign an Audit Owner to a control's failing assets. Grouped metric cards and a jump nav; every card, status bar, failing control, framework and benchmark opens the matching assets in the Compliance Deep-Dive.

widgets.title: Failed checks by audit file
widgets.sql: SELECT c.audit_file, COUNT(*) AS failed FROM compliance c WHERE upper(c.status)='FAILED' AND $__scope(c.asset_uuid) GROUP BY c.audit_file ORDER BY failed DESC LIMIT 15
widgets.drill: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.hostname,''), a.ip_address) AS host, c.audit_file, c.check_name, c.status, c.actual_value, c.expected_value, c.asset_uuid FROM compliance c LEFT JOIN assets a ON a.uuid=c.asset_uuid WHERE upper(c.status)='FAILED' AND $__scope(c.asset_uuid) ORDER BY c.audit_file, host

widgets.title: Compliance pass rate
widgets.note: Passed checks out of passed + failed (warnings excluded).
widgets.sql: SELECT 'Pass rate %' AS metric, COALESCE(ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN upper(c.status)='PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN upper(c.status) IN ('PASSED','FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),1),0) AS pct FROM compliance c WHERE $__scope(c.asset_uuid)

widgets.title: Failed compliance checks
widgets.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Failed checks" FROM compliance c WHERE upper(c.status)='FAILED' AND $__scope(c.asset_uuid)
widgets.drill: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.hostname,''), a.ip_address) AS host, c.audit_file, c.check_name, c.actual_value, c.expected_value, c.asset_uuid FROM compliance c LEFT JOIN assets a ON a.uuid=c.asset_uuid WHERE upper(c.status)='FAILED' AND $__scope(c.asset_uuid) ORDER BY host

widgets.title: Assets failing a check
widgets.note: Assets with at least one FAILED check.
widgets.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.asset_uuid) AS "Failing assets" FROM compliance c WHERE upper(c.status)='FAILED' AND $__scope(c.asset_uuid)

widgets.title: Top failing checks
widgets.note: The checks that fail on the most assets — one fix each.
widgets.sql: SELECT c.check_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.asset_uuid) AS assets FROM compliance c WHERE upper(c.status)='FAILED' AND $__scope(c.asset_uuid) GROUP BY c.check_name ORDER BY assets DESC LIMIT 15

widgets.title: Weakest assets (most failed checks)
widgets.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.hostname,''), a.ip_address, c.asset_uuid) AS host, COUNT(*) AS failed FROM compliance c LEFT JOIN assets a ON a.uuid=c.asset_uuid WHERE upper(c.status)='FAILED' AND $__scope(c.asset_uuid) GROUP BY c.asset_uuid ORDER BY failed DESC LIMIT 15
